global_rules: Build a mobile-only React Web storefront
Use Apple products as the only product catalog
Follow this design system as the single source of truth
Use consistent spacing, typography, colors, and component sizes
Support Light and Dark themes
Use MYR currency formatting with RM symbol
Use RM 52.00 as the fixed checkout shipping fee
Do not invent or activate payment methods while payment is undecided
Persist cart and orders using localStorage
Synchronize the header cart count with the actual cart state
Limit product quantity based on available stock
Keep the application root at 100% height with flex column layout
Keep main content flex 1, min-height 0, and independently scrollable
Keep header and bottom navigation outside the main scrolling area
Respect device safe areas
Prevent horizontal overflow
Use reusable components and consistent page layouts
Provide loading, empty, error, and success states
Do not use desktop layouts or desktop navigation
Do not use nested interactive buttons
Do not change finalized business requirements without approval
